description: Department of Fiscal Policy - Inland Revenue Act No. 24 of 2017
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves the exercise of regulatory powers under the Inland Revenue Act to prescribe specific information technology and enabled services for tax purposes. It contains a legal order issued by the Minister of Finance under statutory authority, amending the application of tax law, which falls squarely under Legal/Regulatory matters (Type 5) rather than government personnel or structural changes.
